newsitem.title: TURKEY: Istanbul Exchange trade resumed at 1133 GMT.
newsitem.headline: Istanbul Exchange trade resumed at 1133 GMT.

text.p: Share trading which temporarily came to a halt due to a technical problem in the computer system at the Istanbul Stock Exchange resumed at 1133 GMT, the Exchange said.
It said the afternoon session would close at 1315 GMT instead of the regular 1300 GMT because of the delay.
Trading had stopped at 1108 GMT, eight minutes after the afternoon session opened, due to a technical problem in the automated trading system.
